title: 1 Kings Bible Quiz - Chapter 1
description: Ten questions on 1 Kings 1: Adonijah tries to make himself king, but David has Solomon anointed at Gihon.

questions.text: Who was found to serve old King David and keep him warm?
questions.explanation: They searched throughout Israel for a beautiful young lady and found Abishag the Shunammite.

questions.text: Who exalted himself, saying, "I will be king"?
questions.explanation: Adonijah the son of Haggith exalted himself, saying, "I will be king," and prepared chariots, horsemen and fifty men to run before him.

questions.text: Who followed Adonijah and helped him?
questions.explanation: Adonijah conferred with Joab the son of Zeruiah and with Abiathar the priest, and they followed him and helped him.

questions.text: Where did Adonijah sacrifice sheep, cattle and fatlings?
questions.explanation: Adonijah killed sheep, cattle and fatlings by the stone of Zoheleth, which is beside En Rogel.

answers.text: By the stone of Zoheleth, beside En Rogel
By the great high place at Gibeon
At the city gate of Hebron
On the top of the Mount of Olives

questions.text: Whom did Nathan advise to go in to King David?
questions.explanation: Nathan spoke to Bathsheba the mother of Solomon and told her to go in to king David.

questions.text: On what did David say Solomon should ride to Gihon?
questions.explanation: David told them to cause Solomon to ride on his own mule and bring him down to Gihon.
They brought Solomon to Gihon, and Zadok the priest anointed him there.

questions.text: What did Zadok take from the Tent to anoint Solomon?
questions.explanation: Zadok the priest took the horn of oil from the Tent and anointed Solomon.

questions.text: Who came to Adonijah's feast with the news that Solomon had been made king?
questions.explanation: Jonathan the son of Abiathar the priest came and told Adonijah that king David had made Solomon king.

questions.text: What did Adonijah do because he was afraid of Solomon?
questions.explanation: Adonijah was afraid because of Solomon, and he went and hung onto the horns of the altar.

answers.text: He fled to Achish the king of Gath
He hung onto the horns of the altar
He hid in a cave in the wilderness
He gathered his army at Hebron
